target.title: fix(mcp): return error instead of zero-byte PNG on empty capture data
target.body:
## Problem

When `capture.imageData` is empty and the saved-file fallback read also fails (`try?` returns `nil`), the `?? capture.imageData` fallback returns the same empty `Data()`. The function then returns `ToolResponse.image(data: emptyData, mimeType: "image/png")`, reporting a zero-byte PNG as a successful capture to the MCP client.

The client has no way to distinguish this from a valid capture, since `isError` is `false` and the MIME type is set.

## Fix

Add an emptiness guard after the data-recovery fallback in `buildCaptureResponse`. When `data.isEmpty`, return `ToolResponse.error(...)` with a descriptive message instead of a zero-byte image response.

## Verification

- `swift build --package-path Apps/CLI` compiles cleanly
- `pnpm run format` passes (SwiftFormat)
- Change is a 5-line guard addition; no behavioral change for successful captures where `data` is non-empty
